versions.changelog:
- Added detailed metadata for configuration file location and required system binaries.
- Introduced human confirmation requirement for "transfer" and "pay" actions.
- Updated zeroConfig and feature flags in skill metadata for improved clarity and control.
- No code or documentation content changes to user-facing features.

AgentWallex Payment skill v1.0.0 initial release

- Enables AI agents to manage agents and perform crypto payments (USDC/USDT) on Ethereum, BSC, and Tron (mainnet & testnet).
- Zero-config setup through conversation — no config files or environment variables required.
- Tools available for agent creation/management, wallet management, checking balances, sending payments, and transaction tracking.
- Credentials validated and stored locally for secure access.
- Supports development/testing in sandbox mode with testnet tokens.
- Requires only system `curl` and `jq` binaries — no API keys needed until setup.
